reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already handles missing, numeric and ranged amounts, instead of re-deriving the rule.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the new field is a single call to the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal and APIScheduleEntity in api-models.ts, where the API shape of schedules is defined.

scope.why: Focused, but also reorders getRangedAmount imports in forecast-schedules.ts and schedules/app.ts, unrelated churn.

maintainability.why: One-line mapping to the canonical helper with a documented read-only field and tests; trivial to own.
